ASSIGNMENT OFLEASESAND RENTS This ASSIGNMENT OF LEASES AND RENTS (this “Assignment") made the 17th day of June, 2026, by 643 E 229TH LLC, a New York limited liability company, having a business address at 9 Austra Parkway, Unit 105, Monroe, New York 10950 (the “Assignor"), to BROADVIEW CAPITAL LLC, a New York limited liability company, having a business address at 98 Cutter Mill Road, Suite 249, Great Neck, New York 11021 ("Lender"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Assignor is or may become the owner and holder of the landlord's interest under certain leases (the “Leases"), which Leases cover various portions of the improvements erected on certain premises described in ExhibitA attached hereto(the "Premises"); WHEREAS, Lender has made a mortgage loan to Assignor in the principal amount of One Million Three Hundred Eighty-One Thousand ($1,381,000.00) Dollars (the "Loan"), evidenced by that certain note (the “Note") executed by Assignor in favor of Lender and secured, in part, by that certain mortgage encumbering the Premises (the “Mortgage") dated on the date hereofexecuted byAssignorinfavor of Lender;and WHEREAS, Lender has agreed to make the Loan to Assignor on the condition that Assignor assign the Leases to Lender in the mannerhereinafter provided as additional security to Lender for the payment of Assignor's obligations under the Note, the Mortgage, this Assignment and all of the other documients executed in connection with the Loan (the “Other Loan Documents"). NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of Lender's agreement to make the Loan toAssignor and other good andvaluable consideration, the receipt and legal sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, Assignor hereby absolutely and unconditionally grants, transfers and covenants and provisions of the Note, the Mortgage, this Assignment and the Other Loan additional rents, charges, issues and profits payable under the Leases from the date hereof to the end of the respective terms of the Leases and any renewals and extensions thereof (coilectively, the “"Rents"), and Assignor hereby represents and warrants to and covenants and agrees with Lender as follows: 1. Assignor further represents and warrants to and covenants and agrees with Lender (whichrepresentations and warranties shallbe true and correct throughout the term of this Assignment) that (i) there are no prior assignments of the Leases or of any portion of the Rents due and payable or tobecome due and payable thereunder which are presently outstanding, (i) the Leases have not been modified or amended, (ii) all of the Leases are in full force and effect and the respective terms thereof have commenced pursuant to the provisions thereof, (iv) the tenants under the Leases have taken possession of the same on a rent-paying basis,(v) neither Assignor nor any tenant under the Leases is in default under any of the terms, covenants and provisions of the Leases and Assignor knows of no event which, with the passage of time or the giving of notice -1-
